summary: Reverted the render-time ReferenceError in Conversation.svelte by passing `ui={extensionUi}` instead of the shorthand `{ui}` (no such variable in scope), removed the temporary ui-bridge diagnostics from the server runtime and store, and committed the fix. Then redesigned the ask_user experience: while a question is pending, the composer is hidden and replaced in-place by a card with a vertical stack of uniform full-width option buttons plus an always-available custom-answer text input; the protocol's 'Write my own answer…' sentinel is hidden from the list but still used under the hood, with typed text queued in the store and the follow-up input request answered automatically.
decisions: Replace the shorthand `{ui}` prop with `ui={extensionUi}` on `<PiExtensionQuestion>` in Conversation.svelte — `ui` is not defined in that component's scope, only `extensionUi` is.
Remove the `[ui-bridge]` console.warn diagnostics from the server runtime and the store; their job (proving the bridge event arrives) is done, and the user's pasted error confirms it.
Pending `ask_user` questions replace the composer in-place (same slot, same visual weight) rather than appearing as a floating dialog above it.

Hide the protocol's 'Write my own answer…' sentinel option from the option list; keep it in the protocol so typed text can still submit through it (select responses must be one of the offered options).
Queue free-text typed for a select request in the store (`queuedCustomAnswer`) and auto-answer the follow-up `input` request with that text — single user-visible step, but protocol-compliant.
Stack option buttons vertically, full-width, min-height 36px, left-aligned text with overflow-wrap: anywhere so long labels wrap cleanly.
Focus the custom-answer text input by default when the question card appears.

The `ask_user` tool itself remains the user's Pi extension at `~/.pi/agent/extensions/ask-user.ts`, with one guard added (`ctx.mode === 'rpc' || ctx.hasUI`) so its bridge path runs under Gizmo's binding; Gizmo ships no duplicate tool.

Gizmo's chat card is the generic extension-UI bridge renderer — any extension's `ui.select`/`ui.input` gets the same card for free; a bespoke Gizmo UI for a specific tool would be a paired web extension bundle shipping with that Pi extension.
ask_user is not vendored into the Gizmo repo in this segment; it stays in the user's agent dir, so the card only activates when that extension is present on the machine.

The next direction raised (for future work, not done here): ship a Pi extension and its Gizmo web UI together as one paired extension package, with the generic chat card as fallback — ask_user as the pilot.
errors: Uncaught ReferenceError: ui is not defined at Conversation.svelte:192 — caused by `<PiExtensionQuestion {ui} {question} />` shorthand where the variable `ui` does not exist (the component's prop is `extensionUi`); rendered when a question actually arrived, so unit tests that didn't trigger a pending question missed it. Fixed by passing `ui={extensionUi}`.
